title: 女枪手 · Claude 大小姐

character.name: Claude 大小姐
character.identity: the same tall slim elegant lady, with the same head size and proportions, very long straight orange hair, orange flower hair ornament with a black ribbon, high ruffled collar with an orange flower brooch and black cravat, cream capelet, full cream sleeves with frilled cuffs, black corset with gold buttons, floor-length bell gown with a cream center, orange front panel, black side panels, gold trim, orange flower bows and a frilled hem, white lace-up boots. Pale skin. Bare hands.
character.hands_rule: All her hands are empty: no gun, no weapon, no book.
